title_zh: 约好巡查员查看通往湖泊的步道上的倒枝

scenario.label_zh: 约好巡查员查看通往湖泊的步道上的倒枝
scenario.goal_zh: 向巡查员说明步道障碍的位置，并约定由其查看而不由报告者搬动

context_zh: 在采用美式拼写的虚构公园场景中，一名步行者向公园巡查员报告倒枝。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Carmen
sentences.text: A motorist in the neighboring parking lot told me a branch was blocking the pathway to the lake. I walked over and saw it too.

sentences.speaker: Ranger Ellis
sentences.text: I patrol that section. Is it near the wooden bridge or farther down the slope?

sentences.speaker: Carmen
sentences.text: Just before the bridge, across most of the path. I came back rather than climb over it.

sentences.speaker: Ranger Ellis
sentences.text: Thanks. I’ll check it now and contact the maintenance team if we need help.

sentences.speaker: Carmen
sentences.text: Should I try moving the smaller end while you’re on your way?

sentences.speaker: Ranger Ellis
sentences.text: No, leave it where it is. I’ll assess it when I arrive.

sentences.speaker: Carmen
sentences.text: All right. I’ll stay here and point you toward the spot.
